channel.title: IBM Corporation — recent CVEs
channel.description: Most recent CVEs assigned by IBM Corporation (ibm).

item.title: CVE-2026-76587 · 8.8 HIGH — IBM Planning Analytics Buffer Overflow
item.description: IBM Planning Analytics 2.0 and 2.1 are vulnerable to a stack-based buffer overflow, caused by improper bounds checking. An attacker could overflow the buffer and execute arbitrary code on the system.

item.title: CVE-2026-9825 · 3.7 LOW 🌩️ — IBM Cyber Fraud Reachable Assertion
item.description: IBM Cyber Fraud 1.0.0 through 1.0.2 has a missing secure attribute allowing sensitive cookies to be transmitted over unencrypted connections, potentially enabling an attacker to intercept session data through network-based attacks.

item.title: CVE-2026-81212 · 10 CRITICAL 🌩️ — DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data Improper Authorization
item.description: IBM DataStage on Cloud Pak for Data 5.4.0.0 allows an unauthenticated user to perform an arbitrary write into shared Redis under any tenant's key. This collapses the platform's credential-encryption boundary and lets an anonymous caller poison any te…

item.title: CVE-2026-82891 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM Guardium Data Protection is affected by a security vulnerability
item.description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.1, and 12.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to use of a hard-coded cryptographic key.

item.title: CVE-2026-87800 · 6.8 MEDIUM — IBM Cyber Fraud includes components with multiple known vulnerabilities
item.description: IBM Cyber Fraud 1.0.0 through 1.0.2 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to unrestricted upload of a file with a dangerous type.

item.title: CVE-2026-92559 · 9.8 CRITICAL 🌩️ — IBM App Connect Enterprise is vulnerable to a credential exposure
item.description: IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information due to binding to an unrestricted IP address.

item.title: CVE-2026-93441 · 8.6 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM QRadar SIEM HTTP Receiver protocol is vulnerable to a denial of service
item.description: IBM QRadar SIEM could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service due to uncontrolled resource consumption.

item.title: CVE-2026-93442 · 8.2 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM QRadar SIEM Out-of-bounds Read
item.description: IBM QRadar SIEM 7.6.0.0 through 7.6.0.4, and 7.5.0 through 7.5.0 Update Package 16 Interim Fix 001 could allow a remote attacker to cause a denial of service or obtain sensitive information due to an out-of-bounds read.

item.description: IBM i 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 could allow an unathenticated remote attacker to bypass security restrictions due to improper access control. By sending a specially crafted HTTP request to any URL within the Navigator application prior to authentication…

item.title: CVE-2026-93888 · 7.8 HIGH — IBM Sterling Connect:Direct for Unix Buffer Overflow
item.description: IBM Sterling Connect Direct for Unix 6.4.0.0 through 6.4.0.6 and 6.3.0.0 through 6.3.0.7 apnotify utility is vulnerable to a code injection due to insufficient validation of user input.

item.description: IBM Carbon Charts 0.4.0 through 1.27.19 is vulnerable to cross-site scripting. The MeterChart component's Title.truncateTitle() function re-inserts a substring of user-supplied label text into the DOM via an unsanitized innerHTML write when the title…

item.title: CVE-2026-105453 · 8.4 HIGH — IBM Sterling Connect:Direct for Unix Improper Privilege Management
item.description: IBM Sterling Connect Direct for Unix 6.3.0.0 through 6.3.0.7 and 6.4.0.0 through 6.4.0.6 could allow a local attacker to gain elevated privileges due to improper privilege management.

item.title: CVE-2026-107400 · 8.8 HIGH — Security Vulnerability identified in IBM TRIRIGA - GWT Mock Authentication
item.description: IBM TRIRIGA Application Platform 5.0.0 through 5.0.8 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code due to improper authentication.

item.title: CVE-2026-109126 · 8.8 HIGH — IBM Verify Identity Access and IBM Security Verify Access Hard-coded Credentials
item.description: IBM Verify Identity Access 11.0.3.1 and IBM Security Verify Access 10.0.9.3 Appliance could allow a physically proximate attacker to gain elevated privileges due to the use of hard-coded credentials.

item.description: IBM Storage TS4500 Library 1.1.1.6 through 1.12.0.3 does not invalidate session after a logout which could allow an authenticated user to impersonate another user on the system.

item.description: IBM Storage TS4500 Library 1.1.1.6 through 1.12.0.3 IBM TS4500 Tape Library/Diamondback Tape Library does not invalidate session which could allow an authenticated user to impersonate another user on the system.

item.title: CVE-2026-19178 · 6.8 MEDIUM — TS4500 Tape Library Race Condition

item.title: CVE-2026-3628 · 5.3 MEDIUM 🌩️ — IBM Concert Software Information Disclosure

item.title: CVE-2026-6719 · 7.5 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM Concert Software Use of Insufficiently Random Values
item.description: IBM Concert 1.0 through 3.0.0 uses weaker than expected cryptographic algorithms that could allow an attacker to decrypt highly sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2026-6930 · 3.7 LOW 🌩️ — IBM Concert Software Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
item.description: IBM Concert 1.0 through 3.0.0 uses weaker than expected cryptographic algorithms that could allow an attacker to decrypt highly sensitive information.

item.title: CVE-2026-14511 · 6.5 MEDIUM — IBM MQ Denial of Service
item.description: IBM MQ 9.4.5.0 through 9.4.5.1 could allow an authenticated user to cause a denial of service by sending a specially crafted message that crashes consuming applications.

item.title: CVE-2026-10572 · 8.8 HIGH — IBM MQ Buffer Overflow
item.description: IBM MQ could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code due to a heap buffer overflow when processing MQPUT operations with malformed message options.

item.title: CVE-2026-10574 · 8.8 HIGH — IBM MQ Buffer Overflow
item.description: IBM MQ could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or potentially execute arbitrary code due to a heap buffer overflow when processing MQPUT or MQPUT1 operations with malformed message handle properties.

item.title: CVE-2026-10743 · 8.8 HIGH — IBM MQ Race Condition
item.description: IBM MQ could allow an authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service or corrupt memory due to improper validation of buffer sizes in MQOPEN operations.

item.title: CVE-2026-11828 · 5.9 MEDIUM 🌩️ — IBM MQ Buffer Overflow
item.description: IBM MQ could allow a remote attacker with queue manager control or man-in-the-middle access on unencrypted channels to cause a denial of service in client applications using asynchronous message consumption due to improper validation of queue name le…

item.title: CVE-2026-11829 · 6.5 MEDIUM — IBM MQ Buffer Overflow

item.title: CVE-2026-12148 · 7.5 HIGH — IBM MQ Deserialization of Untrusted Data

item.title: CVE-2026-12665 · 8.1 HIGH 🌩️ — IBM MQ Buffer Overflow

item.title: CVE-2026-12669 · 3.1 LOW — IBM MQ Out-of-bounds Read

item.title: CVE-2026-12727 · 4.3 MEDIUM — IBM MQ Buffer Overflow

item.title: CVE-2026-12670 · 5.3 MEDIUM — IBM MQ Denial of Service

item.description: IBM i 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 could allow a local attacker to bypass NFS version restrictions due to improper enforcement of the export version flag.
